+title: Vendor ACP schema-v2.0.0-alpha.3 and regenerate
+---
+## What
+Replace the pinned-commit schema with the tagged release `schema-v2.0.0-alpha.3` (published 2026-08-20). Only `schema.json` changes; `meta.json` and `meta.unstable.json` are already byte-identical to the release.
+
+Steps:
+- [ ] Download the release asset: `gh release download schema-v2.0.0-alpha.3 --repo agentclientprotocol/agent-client-protocol --pattern schema.json`. Copy it over `Schema/acp-v2.json` byte-identical. Expected SHA-256: `36e8270fb12d4d067005cc02f729f5433930e6834ab4a72260838ee096d62378`.
+- [ ] Update `Schema/README.md` "Vendored version" section (lines 6-27): set the source to the tag `schema-v2.0.0-alpha.3`, remove the pinned-commit note and the "Differences from alpha.2" paragraph, update the table column header and the `acp-v2.json` digest. Keep the two meta digests unchanged. Write the text in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
+- [ ] Delete `Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Generated/.schema-hash` is NOT necessary: the content hash changes with the file. Run `swift package generate-acp`.
+- [ ] Confirm the generated output contains the new declarations: `public struct AuthCapabilities`, `public struct TerminalAuthCapabilities`, `public struct AuthMethodTerminal` (fields `methodId`, `name`, `description`, `args: [String]`, `env: [EnvVariable]`, `meta`), `case terminal(AuthMethodTerminal)` in `enum AuthMethod` in `Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Generated/Unions.generated.swift`, and `public var auth: AuthCapabilities?` on `ClientCapabilities`.
+- [ ] Update the two stale references in `plan.md` (line 85 and line 378) that say the schema comes from `alpha.2`; say `alpha.3`.
+
+Context: the new schema adds terminal authentication. All changes are additive. The generator already handles the `agent` variant of `AuthMethod`, which has the same `allOf` + `type` const shape as the new `terminal` variant, so no generator change is expected. If `swift package generate-acp` or `VendoredSchemaTests` shows a generator gap, fix it in `Sources/ACPGenerateCore/SchemaGenerator.swift` and add a unit test in `Tests/ACPGenerateTests/`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `shasum -a 256 Schema/acp-v2.json` prints `36e8270fb12d4d067005cc02f729f5433930e6834ab4a72260838ee096d62378`.
+- [ ] `swift package generate-acp` then `git diff --exit-code Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Generated` exits 0 after the regenerated files are committed (the CI diff gate).
+- [ ] `Schema/README.md` names the tag, has no pinned-commit note, and its `acp-v2.json` digest matches the file.
+- [ ] `AuthMethod.terminal`, `AuthMethodTerminal`, `AuthCapabilities`, `TerminalAuthCapabilities`, and `ClientCapabilities.auth` exist in the generated sources.
+- [ ] `plan.md` no longer says the vendored schema is `alpha.2`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `swift test` passes in full, including `Tests/ACPGenerateTests/VendoredSchemaTests.swift` (in-memory generation equals checked-in files) and `Tests/FoundationModelsACPTests/TaggedUnionRoundTripTests.swift` (the exhaustive-over-tags half now includes `terminal` and must select `.terminal`, not `.unknown`).
+- [ ] `cd IntegrationTests && swift test` passes (`SchemaConformanceTests` validates against the vendored schema).
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #schema-alpha3
\ No newline at end of file
